recipe.label: Clay Diorama

traits.medium: hand-formed colored-clay miniature reinterpretation of an architectural scene
traits.texture: rounded clay edges, tiny fingerprints and soft handmade surface imperfections
traits.composition: preserve the upward view and diagonal facade; model windows, railing and cloud as simple clay forms
traits.lighting: soft directional daylight with shallow miniature shadows

review_checks: windows and railing retain their rhythm
lighting supports a coherent miniature scene
limitations: Raster visualization only; no 3D model, mesh, construction plan or physically accurate material is supplied.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: One reviewed Clay Diorama example for the Art Skill style catalog
Primary request: An upward view of a warm beige building with a diagonal roofline, a slim roof railing and red-trimmed windows in the lower part of the frame, beneath a vast blue sky, a small soft white cloud and a faint rainbow patch. Small foliage sits along the lower edge.
Style/medium: hand-formed colored-clay miniature reinterpretation of an architectural scene
Color palette: #E3D0A5, #789FA9, #B87359, #F2E9D6, #5B6F50
Materials/textures: rounded clay edges, tiny fingerprints and soft handmade surface imperfections
Composition/framing: preserve the upward view and diagonal facade; model windows, railing and cloud as simple clay forms; Keep portrait orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: soft directional daylight with shallow miniature shadows
Requested output target: 1024x1536, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original upward viewpoint, diagonal building line, window rhythm, broad empty sky, small cloud placement and faint rainbow motif. Do not add a sea, mountains, a garden terrace or a sunset.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
